description: Source code implementing AVX512-based precoding functions for wireless communication, including SIMD operations, layer mapping, and precoding application.

classes.name: simd_cf_t
classes.description: Represents a set of complex numbers using AVX512 registers for real and imaginary parts.

classes.name: simd_cf_interleaved
classes.description: Type alias for AVX512 register with interleaved real and imaginary parts.

methods.name: set1
methods.description: Initializes simd_cf_t with a complex constant.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Performs SIMD multiplication for precoding weights.

methods.name: ps_to_cbf16
methods.description: Converts SIMD complex float data to 16-bit fixed point format.

methods.name: from_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Converts 8-bit fixed point input to complex float SIMD registers.

methods.name: layer2_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Maps and converts input data for 2-layer processing.

methods.name: layer3_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Maps and converts input data for 3-layer processing.

methods.name: layer4_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Maps and converts input data for 4-layer processing.

methods.name: apply_precoding_port
methods.description: Applies precoding weights to input RE data for a specific port.

methods.name: apply_layer_map_and_precoding
methods.description: Performs layer mapping and precoding on input data, supporting multiple layers and ports.
